productArea.name: Packages
productArea.scope: Find and manage packages through user, organization, repository, and administrator inventories, including search, versions, details, downloads, settings, deletion, and cleanup rules. Repository management and external package publishing clients are outside this area.

entryPoints.directions: Choose Packages on the user profile and open a package for its versions, files, and settings. If empty, upload a nonempty disposable file with PUT /api/packages/momentic-admin/generic/eval-package/1.0.0/example.txt using the seeded account as a prerequisite.
Choose Packages in the seeded repository to inspect linked packages.
Choose Packages in user settings to manage cleanup rules and inspect their previews.
Choose Site Administration then Packages to inspect the instance inventory.
Open an organization you can access and choose Packages, or Settings then Packages for cleanup rules. Create a disposable organization if none exists.
